questions.q: What are Dhul Majaz, Ukaz and Majannah?
options: Great Hajj-season markets where tribes from the whole Peninsula met
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW met tribes in the markets and camps.

questions.q: Why was Suwayd bin Samit called Al-Kamil?
options: Because of his skill in poetry and his noble lineage
questions.explain: The Prophet listened to Suwayd's recitation before offering something better.

questions.q: What is Aqabah in this lecture?
options: A place in Mina where the Prophet SAW met six young Khazraj men
questions.explain: They lived beside the Jews and saw him as the prophet they spoke of.

options: A post that deliberately provokes anger so it is shared and commented on
questions.explain: Listen to the person himself, not about him.

questions.q: Why did Abu Bakr prepare a profile of each tribe?
options: So that the Prophet SAW could tailor his approach to the audience
questions.explain: Adapt the approach to the audience.

questions.q: What did the companions teach for when one is praised?
options: A prayer so as not to be intoxicated by praise

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW do despite mockery and rejection each time?
The Prophet listened to Suwayd's recitation first before offering something better.
Da'wah is only the work of religious people.
questions.explain: False. The companions were traders, commanders, farmers and students.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Six become twelve a year later
Six young men of Khazraj respond
Meeting tribes in markets and camps

questions.explain: Without a protector, meeting tribes, being refused, six young men responded, and a year later twelve.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The title of Suwayd bin Samit

questions.explain: Dhul Majaz is a market, Al-Kamil is Suwayd's title, Aqabah is in Mina, and a tribe is an Arab clan.

questions.q: Calling the closest family is hardest. What is the lesson of this lecture?
options: The obstacle is the way forward
questions.explain: Without obstacles there is no growth.
